A.label: 夜·童年
A.time: a deep indigo night sky scattered with fine stars, faint cool clouds and tiny warm city lights beneath a distant immense wall
A.scene: a quiet stone-paved alley framed by tall old ink-drawn stone buildings on both sides; a distant immense wall remains part of the colored atmospheric background
A.people: exactly three original children sitting on the cobblestones, seen from behind, in simple unmarked clothing, quietly looking toward the far wall
A.emotion: longing, childhood promises and quiet companionship

B.label: 黄昏·孤独
B.time: a luminous purple-pink sunset with a low warm sun, subtle radiant beams and hazy distant hills
B.scene: a ruined high stone terrace with broken walls, scattered masonry and a quiet distant landscape
B.people: exactly one original young cloaked traveler standing on the broken stone terrace, back view, cloak gently lifted by wind, calm and still

C.label: 晴天·羁绊
C.time: a clear luminous blue daytime sky with large dimensional white cumulus clouds, cool distant hills and an atmospheric walled city
C.scene: the top of a broad stone wall or rampart, with a colored city and mountains in the far distance
C.people: exactly five original companions in matching generic unmarked uniforms, standing in a calm row with their backs to the viewer, no logos or distinctive franchise equipment
C.emotion: bonds, departure, shared duty and protection

D.label: 黎明·终章
D.time: a pale lavender and soft pink dawn becoming light gold near the open sea horizon, a restrained brightening sky and distant mist
D.scene: a quiet coastal cliff, a simple ink-drawn rock ledge and sparse grass in the foreground, expansive colored sea and horizon beyond
D.people: exactly one original traveler sitting quietly on a coastal rock ledge, seen from behind, looking toward the far sea horizon, simple cloak and clothing
D.emotion: peace after an ending, acceptance and a new beginning
